name: Diamondnode North Star MRR
description: 13 streams × $70k MRR, procedural truth crystal, R01 inference cash path
schema_status_reason: No AXIOM_TOKEN/ORG in vault; getschema never run; scorecard/cycle events not ingested to Axiom. Local truth remains reports/*-latest.json.

panels.name: North Star
panels.question: What are the goals and decisions?

panels.name: Total MRR (USD)
panels.question: Are we on the cash path?

total-mrr.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "goal_scorecard" or isnotnull(total_mrr_usd)
| top 1 by _time desc
| project total_mrr_usd
| summarize total_mrr_usd=any(total_mrr_usd)

streams-at-floor.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "goal_scorecard" or isnotnull(streams_at_floor)
| top 1 by _time desc
| project streams_at_floor
| summarize streams_at_floor=any(streams_at_floor)

r01-estimated-mrr.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "r01_go_live" or event == "goal_scorecard" or isnotnull(r01_estimated_mrr) or (stream == "R01" and isnotnull(estimated_mrr))
| extend r01_mrr = coalesce(r01_estimated_mrr, estimated_mrr, stream_R01_mrr)
| top 1 by _time desc
| summarize r01_estimated_mrr=any(r01_mrr)

ptv-crystal.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where isnotnull(crystal_value) or event == "goal_scorecard" or event == "procedural_truth"
| top 1 by _time desc
| summarize crystal_value=any(crystal_value)

go-live-blockers.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "r01_go_live" or isnotnull(go_live_blockers_count)
| top 1 by _time desc
| summarize blockers=any(go_live_blockers_count)

ops-cycle-health.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "ops_cycle" or event == "goal_scorecard" or isnotnull(verification_ok)
| summarize ok=countif(verification_ok == true or cycle_ok == true), n=count()
| extend pct = iff(n > 0, (todouble(ok) / todouble(n)) * 100.0, 0.0)
| project pct

mrr-trend.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where isnotnull(total_mrr_usd)
| summarize total_mrr_usd=max(total_mrr_usd) by bin_auto(_time)

stream-mrr-table.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "goal_scorecard" or isnotnull(stream_R01_mrr)
| top 1 by _time desc
| project stream_R01_mrr, stream_R02_mrr, stream_R03_mrr, stream_R04_mrr, stream_R05_mrr, stream_R06_mrr, stream_R07_mrr, stream_R08_mrr, stream_R09_mrr, stream_R10_mrr, stream_R11_mrr, stream_R12_mrr, stream_R13_mrr, streams_at_floor, total_mrr_usd

blockers-evidence.apl:
['ops-maintenance']
| where event == "r01_go_live" or isnotnull(go_live_blockers)
| project _time, stream, go_live_blockers_count, go_live_blockers, public_url, stripe_webhook_secret
| sort by _time desc
| take 50

ops-revenue-optional.note: Optional second dataset for cash ledger deltas
ops-revenue-optional.apl:
['ops-revenue']
| where isnotnull(delta_mrr) or isnotnull(delta_cash)
| summarize delta_mrr=sum(delta_mrr), delta_cash=sum(delta_cash) by bin_auto(_time), stream
